headline: Kane signs new Bayern deal to 2029 weeks after winning the Ballon d'Or
facts: Bayern announced on 5 November 2026 that Kane's contract now runs to summer 2029.
Sky in Germany reported a salary of at least about 25 million euros gross per year; no release clause was mentioned.
Kane, 33, has 156 goals in 161 games for Bayern since joining from Tottenham in 2023.
background: Kane left Tottenham in 2023 without winning a trophy there; at Bayern he has won two Bundesliga titles, the German Cup and the German Super Cup.
footage_terms: Harry Kane new contract Bayern Munich

headline: Harry Kane wins the 2026 Ballon d'Or, first Englishman in 25 years
facts: Kane scored 73 goals for club and country last season, 61 of them for Bayern.
He is only the fifth Englishman to win the award and the first in 25 years.
ESPN reports he beat Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal and is Bayern's fourth Ballon d'Or winner after Beckenbauer, Muller and Rummenigge.
background: Kane started out with forgettable loan spells in the lower English leagues before becoming Tottenham's all-time top scorer, yet he never won a trophy at Spurs.

headline: Kane parades Ballon d'Or, then misses a penalty as Dortmund snatch a 2-2 draw in Der Klassiker
facts: Bayern 2-2 Dortmund on 31 October 2026 at the Allianz Arena; Laimer (38') and Upamecano (66') scored for Bayern, Guirassy (60') and Silva (89') for Dortmund.
Kane showed the Ballon d'Or to fans before kick-off, then hit the crossbar with a 57th-minute penalty and was dispossessed before Guirassy's goal.
Both clubs stayed unbeaten and level on points at the top of the Bundesliga; Gnabry and Saibari went off injured for Bayern.
background: Bayern beat Dortmund 3-2 in the previous league meeting in February 2026 with a Kane brace and a late Kimmich volley.

headline: Kane's Munich homecoming: guard of honour, a golden schnitzel joke and a knighthood question
facts: Kane did not play in the 6-1 cup win over Magdeburg but received a guard of honour and fan chants at the Allianz Arena.
He said his children played with the Ballon d'Or trophy and that being called 'Sir' would feel odd; he said he would not turn down a knighthood.
Former Bayern president Uli Hoeness first called the transfer fee crazy but now says he would have paid 150 million euros for Kane.
background: Hoeness, long Bayern's club president, was among those who doubted the size of Kane's 2023 fee when Bayern signed him from Tottenham.
footage_terms: Kane Ballon d'Or guard of honour Bayern

headline: Bayern coach Kompany collapses at training, treated for meningeal irritation
facts: Kompany collapsed at the training ground on Friday 23 October during a second-team session; Max Eberl said the cause was meningeal irritation.
He had missed duties earlier that week with a viral infection and was discharged from hospital on 28 October.
Assistant coach Aaron Danks took charge of the team during his absence.
background: Kompany took over at Bayern in 2024 after relegation with Burnley, a hire that Karl-Heinz Rummenigge says he first doubted before Pep Guardiola backed him.

headline: Kompany returns to the Bayern touchline for Cologne after five games away
facts: Kompany is set to coach Bayern against Cologne on 20 November after missing five games; he says his tests are clear.
Under Danks Bayern stayed unbeaten across those five games, including a 2-0 win at Atletico Madrid that Kompany called a highlight of his coaching career.
Bundesliga.com notes he still wore a sling for a shoulder injury at Thursday's press conference.
background: Kompany captained Manchester City under Pep Guardiola, who now praises him as a natural coach.
footage_terms: Kompany return Bayern Cologne press conference

headline: Arsenal fight back to draw 2-2 at Bayern in the Champions League
facts: Eze (25') and Rice (82') scored for Arsenal; Davies (35') and a Kane penalty (61') scored for Bayern.
Eze's goal was first ruled offside, then VAR found him onside; Kane's penalty followed a handball by Jurrien Timber.
Bayern were without the suspended Michael Olise; Neuer made a late save to keep the point.
background: Kane scored his 16th goal in 22 appearances against Arsenal in this match, a record carried over from his Tottenham years.

headline: Viking 3-3 Bayern: Norwegian side lead twice, Olise sent off for two quick yellows
facts: Viking led 2-0 by half-time; Kane scored a penalty and a header, then Diaz and Olise put Bayern 3-2 up.
Olise was booked twice in quick succession and Bayern played the rest with ten men.
Herman Haugen headed Viking's late equaliser in the 90th minute in Stavanger.
background: Bayern started this Champions League league phase with a 5-0 win at Bodo/Glimt, another Norwegian side, on 10 September.
footage_terms: Viking FK Bayern Munich Champions League

headline: Bayern thrash Leipzig 6-1 as Luis Diaz scores a hat-trick
facts: Bayern won 6-1 at the Allianz Arena on 17 October; Diaz scored three, with Pavlovic, Olise and Kane adding one each per ESPN's scorer list.
Leipzig's only goal came in stoppage time.
The result moved Bayern back to the top of the Bundesliga.
background: Luis Diaz joined Bayern from Liverpool in 2025, where he had been a regular goalscorer on the left wing.

headline: Augsburg score within seconds at Bayern, who escape with a 2-2 draw
facts: Sky's highlights headline says Bayern fell behind after just six seconds before escaping a scare.
ESPN lists the match as 2-2 on 10 October, with Fellhauer scoring in the first minute after a Neuer mistake.
Saibari (55') and Nathaniel Brown (80') scored for Bayern.
background: Manuel Neuer has been Bayern's goalkeeper since 2011 and is credited by Rummenigge as the origin of the modern sweeper-keeper game.

headline: Atletico 0-2 Bayern in Madrid as Karl chips Oblak, with Kompany still away
facts: Karl scored in the 54th minute by chipping Jan Oblak; Laimer added a second in the 74th minute from a lofted Kane pass.
Atletico's expected goals were 0.83 against Bayern's 1.77.
Assistant Aaron Danks was in charge while Kompany recovered.
background: Karl came through Bayern's youth system and became the youngest player to score in three consecutive Champions League games last season.

headline: Kane sets up both goals in 2-1 win at Mainz but is stuck in a four-game goal drought
facts: Mainz 1-2 Bayern on 7 November: Kimmich (14') and Karl (57') scored from Kane assists; Tietz scored for Mainz in stoppage time.
Sky says Kane has gone four games without a goal, which has happened only once before in his Bayern career, while his eight Bundesliga assists lead the league.
Bundesliga.com reports Manuel Neuer injured his foot at Mainz and remains out.
background: Kane built his name as a pure goalscorer but has reinvented himself as a deep-lying playmaker, a change he credits partly to Jose Mourinho's freedom at Tottenham.

headline: Davies tears left hamstring on Canada duty and misses Cologne
facts: Bayern confirmed on 16 November that Davies has a minor tear in his left hamstring.
He captained Canada against Guatemala and went off after about six to seven minutes in a 3-2 win.
He is expected to miss several games, including the Cologne match on 20 November.
background: Davies joined Bayern from Vancouver Whitecaps in 2019 and has played 15 matches in all competitions this season.

headline: Bayern injury list grows: Diaz, Gnabry, Saibari and Neuer all out
facts: Diaz tore a muscle against Arsenal on 21 October and was back in parts of team training on 12 November.
Saibari had right ankle surgery and Gnabry a hamstring injury after the 2-2 draw with Dortmund.
Musiala trained alongside Diaz while recovering from a muscle injury; Neuer is out with a foot injury.
background: Musiala said in August that he has treatable absence seizures and chose to keep playing after neurologists cleared him.

headline: Real Madrid still tracking Bayern's Olise, L'Equipe reports
facts: ESPN, citing L'Equipe, says Real Madrid remain interested in Olise after being linked with him in the summer.
Several top European clubs reportedly want him next summer, when he will have two years left on his Bayern contract.
This is a rumour; no bid or agreement has been reported.
background: Olise joined Bayern from Crystal Palace in 2024 and is ranked third in ESPN's November list of the best players in the world.

headline: ESPN ranks Olise third and Kane fifth among the world's best players
facts: ESPN's November 10 Best list has Yamal first, Jude Bellingham second and Olise third (up from fifth).
Kane, the reigning Ballon d'Or winner, is ranked fifth, down from fourth.
No Dortmund player makes the top ten.
background: Kane won the Ballon d'Or less than a month earlier after scoring 73 goals for club and country last season.
footage_terms: Harry Kane Ballon d'Or winner ranking

headline: Bayern still chasing Liverpool teenager Rio Ngumoha for a left wing
facts: ESPN, citing Bild's Christian Falk, says Bayern are still negotiating for the 18-year-old.
In the summer Bayern were prepared to offer 70 million euros before signing Ismael Saibari instead.
Bayern still lack a left winger, so a January or summer move could return.
background: Ngumoha is a teenage winger who broke through at Liverpool, a club Bayern also raided for Luis Diaz in 2025.

headline: Barcelona enquire about Bayern defender Jonathan Tah
facts: Sky Sports Deutschland reports Barcelona have asked about the 30-year-old centre-back ahead of January.
Deco wants an experienced defender to play alongside Pau Cubarsi.
Bayern have little interest in selling; Tah is contracted to 2029 and is not considering a move.
background: Tah moved to Bayern from Bayer Leverkusen in 2025 after winning the 2023-24 Bundesliga title at Leverkusen.

headline: Bayern's backup-goalkeeper shortlist: Baumann, Leno and Karius
facts: Sky Sports Deutschland reports Bayern want an experienced back-up goalkeeper for next season.
Oliver Baumann of Hoffenheim, Bernd Leno of Fulham and Loris Karius of Schalke are the names being considered.
Karius made five saves in Schalke's 0-0 draw with Bayern on 5 September.
background: Karius is best known for his errors in Liverpool's 2018 Champions League final defeat to Real Madrid.

headline: Kane breaks Shilton's England caps record with his 126th appearance
facts: Kane won his 126th England cap against Croatia at Wembley on 12 November in the Nations League.
Peter Shilton's total of 125 had stood as the England record for 36 years; Kane matched it a month earlier.
Southgate said Kane may not be a 'better' player than two years ago but has more belief.
background: Kane lost the Euro 2020 and Euro 2024 finals with England under Gareth Southgate, who managed him for eight years.

headline: Patriots QB Drake Maye says Kane could be an NFL kicker after football
facts: Maye said Kane's dead-ball skill and calm under pressure suit an NFL kicking job.
He spoke before the Patriots played the Lions at Munich's Allianz Arena that Sunday.
Kane said in September he would need six months to a year of serious training; he says Bayern come first.
background: Kane has joked before about switching to American football; his Bayern contract now runs to 2029.

headline: Lions beat Patriots 35-10 at Bayern's Allianz Arena as Bundesliga extends NFL deal
facts: Detroit beat New England 35-10 on 15 November in Munich, the sixth regular-season NFL game in Germany.
The Bundesliga and NFL extended their memorandum of understanding on 10 November 2026.
Bayern's Jamal Musiala attended the game.
background: The first NFL regular-season game in Germany was Buccaneers 21, Seahawks 16 in Munich in 2022.
footage_terms: Lions Patriots Munich Allianz Arena highlights

headline: Rummenigge reveals how Guardiola's 90-minute call sold him on Kompany
facts: Rummenigge says Bayern spoke to several coaches before Kompany and he was hesitant because Kompany had just been relegated.
He phoned Guardiola, who gave a candid endorsement in a call of about an hour and a half.
He calls Kane a role model and Neuer the best goalkeeper in Bayern's history.
background: Rummenigge, a former Bayern star and long-time executive, helped arrange Kane's move from Tottenham.

headline: Guardiola praises Kompany and the Bundesliga from his coaching break
facts: Guardiola says he is on a break from coaching and does not know how long it will last.
He calls Kompany destined to coach and says Bayern's attacking, winning style is a joy to watch.
He spends time in Catalonia and Abu Dhabi, plays golf and reads, and watched most of the World Cup from Barcelona.
background: Guardiola coached Bayern for three seasons, winning three Bundesliga titles and two German Cups, before ten years at Manchester City.

headline: Upamecano is three games short of Boateng's Bundesliga unbeaten record
facts: Upamecano has played 53 straight Bundesliga games without defeat, three short of Boateng's all-time record of 56.
He has passed Ribery, Neuer and Thomas Muller and sits third, behind Hradecky's 54.
His last league defeat was a 4-2 loss at Hoffenheim on the last day of 2023-24 under Thomas Tuchel.
background: Upamecano joined Bayern from RB Leipzig in 2021.

headline: Bayern's Karl and Cologne's El Mala: Germany's rising stars meet
facts: Karl scored 5 goals and gave 4 assists in 24 Bundesliga games last season and made his Germany debut against Switzerland in March 2026.
A muscle injury in June cost him the 2026 World Cup.
El Mala was released by Gladbach as a youth, played for TSV Meerbusch and Viktoria Cologne, and now wears Cologne's number 10.
background: Karl made his Bundesliga debut at 17 years and 181 days and first played for Bayern's senior team at the 2025 Club World Cup.

headline: Bayern and Dortmund level on 21 points in the Bundesliga's tightest title race in years
facts: After nine matchdays both teams are unbeaten with 21 points; Bayern lead on goal difference.
Dortmund's 21 points are their best nine-game start since 2013-14 and they have the league's stingiest defence.
Freiburg are two points behind and Leipzig three, the closest top three since 2019-20.
background: The last time two teams were level after nine games was 2017-18, when Bayern and Dortmund each had 20 and Bayern still won the title by 21 points.

headline: Bayern's xG luck: unlucky, while Dortmund are lucky and good
facts: Connelly rates Bayern unlucky: they dropped points at Schalke (0-0) and Augsburg (2-2) despite big expected-goals margins.
Kane had four league goals from shots worth 5.2 expected goals at that point.
Dortmund had allowed goals in just two league games, with keeper Gregor Kobel praised but regression expected.
background: Dortmund finished second last season under Niko Kovac and conceded fewer goals than any other side.

headline: Dortmund to end Rheinmetall sponsorship in 2027 after years of fan protest
facts: Chairman Carsten Cramer confirmed Dortmund will not renew the deal when it expires on 30 June 2027.
Media reports at signing put the deal at up to 9 million euros a year, and Cramer said the lost income will limit flexibility.
Fans had protested since 2024, including with a dummy tank, and members voted against extending beyond 2027.
background: Rheinmetall is Germany's largest arms maker, founded in 1889, and used forced labour in World War II.

headline: Klopp tells Nmecha to drop his crown celebration after Dortmund supporters complain
facts: Nmecha mimed lifting a crown off his head after scoring twice in Dortmund's 2-1 win over Elversberg on 7 November.
A Dortmund supporters' group said the linked Ballers in God campaign discriminates against gay and transgender people; the group says it shows love and respect for all.
Germany coach Klopp spoke to Nmecha, accepted his explanation and said he will not celebrate that way again.
background: Klopp managed Dortmund from 2008 to 2015 and is now Germany's coach.

headline: Dortmund launch app that rewards fans for locking their phones in the stadium
facts: A 'fan mode' in the club app counts phone unlocks during a match, excluding half-time, and fewer unlocks earn more points.
Top fans win prizes such as signed jerseys and merchandise gift cards; the scheme is voluntary.
It started with the home game against Eintracht Frankfurt on 24 October.
background: Dortmund's Yellow Wall is among Europe's best-known stands, and the club says selfies and livestreams are hurting stadium atmosphere.

headline: Dortmund extend Kovac's contract to 2029
facts: Dortmund announced on 13 October that Kovac's deal now runs to June 2029.
The club says his 2.15 points per Bundesliga game is the best of any Dortmund coach.
His brother Robert and assistant Filip Tapalovic also extended.
background: Kovac took over in January 2025 with Dortmund 11th, finished fourth that season and second last season.

headline: Bodo/Glimt beat Dortmund 1-0 in the Arctic Circle
facts: Fredrik Sjovold scored in the 52nd minute from a Sondre Auklend cross in Bodo, Norway.
Dortmund were below their best for long spells and only pressed late; Nmecha was denied in stoppage time.
Expected goals were about 1.1 for Bodo/Glimt and 0.8 for Dortmund.
background: Bodo/Glimt play at the small Aspmyra stadium in northern Norway, where the crowd for this match was 7,885; Bayern had beaten them 5-0 in this league phase.

headline: Sabitzer's 93rd-minute winner saves Dortmund against Bremen's Fullkrug in the cup
facts: Dortmund won 3-2 in the German Cup second round on 27 October, going 2-0 up through Guirassy (6') and Chukwuemeka (17').
Fullkrug scored a 65th-minute penalty and equalised in the 68th minute for Bremen.
Sabitzer scored the winner in stoppage time.
background: Fullkrug is a former Dortmund striker who now plays for Bremen.
footage_terms: Dortmund Werder Bremen 3-2 DFB Pokal highlights

headline: Silva scores as Dortmund edge Real Betis 2-1; Guirassy hurt in the first half
facts: Silva scored in the 49th minute and 18-year-old Karetsas hit the 72nd-minute winner at Signal Iduna Park.
Aitor Ruibal equalised for Betis in the 67th minute.
Dortmund moved to 9 points after four Champions League matches.
background: Wolves signed Silva from Porto for about 30 million pounds at 18; he scored four Premier League goals in 62 games and has since had six loans and moves across Europe.

headline: Guirassy hurts thigh against Betis and will miss Elversberg
facts: Guirassy hurt his thigh around the 31st minute against Betis and was replaced by Karetsas.
Kovac described it as a muscle strain; no return date was given.
He has eight goals in 14 games this season, four of them in four Champions League matches.
background: Guirassy scored 22 Bundesliga goals for Dortmund last season while Fabio Silva scored three.

headline: Jobe Bellingham gets his first England call-up to join brother Jude
facts: Tuchel named the 21-year-old for the Nations League games against Croatia on 12 November and Spain on 15 November.
Bundesliga.com says he has started seven of Dortmund's nine league games and has no league goal yet but two assists.
Kovac called him a 'complete football freak'; Tuchel said he earned the place on merit.
background: Jude Bellingham played for Dortmund from 2020 to 2023 before joining Real Madrid; Jobe went from Birmingham to Sunderland to Dortmund.
footage_terms: Jobe Bellingham England call up Tuchel

headline: Liverpool reportedly hold Dortmund's Nmecha in high regard
facts: ESPN, citing Sky Germany, says Liverpool rate the 26-year-old midfielder highly.
He is not a current priority but that could change as Liverpool reinforce midfield.
His Dortmund contract runs to June 2030.
background: Nmecha is a Germany international who joined Dortmund from Wolfsburg in 2023 and scored twice against Elversberg on 7 November.
